raw: Agent Name: BiblicalScholar_Expert, Step Number: 2, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the first place named in Esther (NIV) as “Susa.” In Esther 1:1 the first place mentioned is “India” (…stretching from India to Cush), while “Susa” appears in verse 2. This led the team to check Iran’s prime minister (Amir-Abbas Hoveyda) instead of India’s, whose PM in April 1977 was Morarji Desai.
